en: Choose the app's color: 8 colors in Settings → Appearance
Series: next and previous episode buttons, and the next episode starts after a 10-second countdown you can cancel
Settings are now organized into six pages
Smoother scrolling on TVs, and lists stop at the last item when you hold Down
On TVs, the big skip buttons on the picture are now hidden by default
